text:
alice: Noticed customers report mixed v1/v2 payloads during migration. Looks like header loss in internal hops. Anyone else?

omar: Yep, saw traces where edge had `X-Client-Ver: v2` but svc proxy had no client header.

jin: Ingress sidecars run header-sanitizer; it strips unknown headers for caching. That likely removed the header.

mike: For routing we rely on `client.version` span tag. Proposal: stamp `client.version` at the edge and copy to the request span. Also add `header.propagation=ok|stripped` tag.

console-product: Console chart mixes client-reported and routing-observed counts. We should show them separately and label routing-observed as billing source-of-truth.

omar: Billing team: we'll dedupe by `request_id` when both client header and runtime variant exist. Implement behind flag first.

infra-bot: PR created: allowlist `X-Redwood-Client-Ver` passthrough + stamp span tag. CI checks passing. ETA: 2h to staging.

alice: Agreed action items: 1) edge stamp `client.version` + `header.propagation` (infra), 2) allowlist canonical header (infra), 3) meter dedupe by request_id (billing), 4) console split chart + tooltip (console-product), 5) integration test to simulate strip (qa).

jin: I'll also add an integration test that simulates strip and verifies console shows two series.

mike: After staging canary, monitor divergence alert for 24h. If >1% sustained, rollback header passthrough.

alice: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short migration note for SDK owners to prefer `X-Redwood-Client-Ver`.
